proper_mask_reachability: For exact mask F on D, restricting all lists to A(v) cap F prevents outside colors.
Forcing one distinct witness vertex w_c=c for each c in F guarantees every color of F appears.
Every exact-F coloring contains at least one witness for every c and therefore appears in one enumerated witness branch.
Every nonempty proper F has size at most 3, so every branch is one common-palette List-3 instance on induced P7-free G[D].
At most |D|^3 witness tuples are required; empty-mask cases are decided without an oracle.
full_mask: For B-C, a difference between mu(F) and mu(F union {alpha}) is impossible when alpha already belongs to F, and therefore impossible to first arise at F=[4].
For C-X0, every nonempty component has mu([4])=0 under every base-list system because all residual lists become empty.
Hence no List-4 reachability query is required.
B_C_exactness: C2 gives D_C nonempty for every final residual component.
If removing b would make D^-=empty, the anticomplete alternative is not a final source-valid state, so it is excluded from the two-sided transition domain.
If Delta_BC is empty, every legal local boundary coloring gamma has a proper-mask F or trivial F=[4], and the two mu values coincide.
If Delta_BC contains (F,alpha), monotonicity implies alpha notin F and mu(F)=1, mu(F union {alpha})=0.
An exact-F rho witness together with b=alpha is proper even across arbitrary b-D^- edges because all D^- colors lie in F and alpha is outside F.
Thus the witness exactly distinguishes the two local component-boundary relations.
C_X0_exactness: D_C is unchanged and nonempty under a C-X0 identity/base-list transition.
Both base systems are independently compiled by C0 on every nonempty mask.
Every actual boundary mask is nonempty; full mask cannot distinguish; every proper reachable mask is decided by rho_D.
Therefore reachable-message equality is necessary and sufficient for equality of the local component-boundary relation.
finite_message_algebra: Independent enumeration gives 168 downward-closed Boolean tables on 4 colors.
Exactly one has mu([4])=1; therefore 167 satisfy the necessary actual-nonempty-component condition mu([4])=0.
Across all 168 tables there are 1688 single-color union inequalities, and every one has alpha notin F and direction 1 -> 0.
There are 15 proper masks, 14 of them nonempty; witness forcing never exceeds three colors.
